# Software Engineer CV for Career Change in United Kingdom

Create a professional Software Engineer cv tailored for career changers in United Kingdom. ATS-optimized. Free to use.

## CV Format Tips for United Kingdom

Do not include photo (not required in United Kingdom)

### Key United Kingdom CV Requirements

2 pages is standard, graduates can use 1 page

Not required

Not needed

## Resume Tips for Career Change Software Engineers

For professionals transitioning to a new industry or role (Varies)

- Transferable skills
- Relevant side projects
- New certifications and training
- Passion and motivation
- Highlight transferable skills relevant to Software Engineer

- Lack of direct experience
- Explaining the career change
- Competing with experienced candidates
- Reframing past experience

### Target Audience

## Key Skills for Software Engineer

- AWS Certified Developer
- Google Cloud Professional
- Azure Developer Associate
- Kubernetes Certification

- Bachelor's in Computer Science
- Bachelor's in Software Engineering
- Coding Bootcamp + Experience
- Self taught + Portfolio

### ATS Keywords to Include

## Sample Resume Content for Career Change

Senior Software Engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable web applications. Expert in React, Node.js, and AWS with a track record of improving system performance by 40%+ and leading teams of 5-8 engineers. Passionate about clean code, mentorship, and delivering user focused solutions.

Tip: Customize this summary with your specific achievements and the company name you're applying to.

Use these as inspiration for your experience section. Always quantify results when possible.

- 1Architected and built microservices platform serving 2M+ daily active users with 99.9% uptime
- 2Reduced API response times by 60% through database optimization and caching strategies
- 3Led migration from monolith to microservices architecture, improving deployment frequency from monthly to daily
- 4Mentored 5 junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical design sessions
- 5Implemented CI/CD pipeline reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes

### Writing Tips for Career Change

- •Start each bullet with a strong action verb
- •Include numbers and metrics whenever possible
- •Focus on achievements, not just responsibilities
- •Tailor content to match job description keywords
